component.name: LanBridge
component.summary: Share a keyboard and mouse between Linux and macOS
在 Linux 与 Mac 之间共享键盘和鼠标

description.p: LanBridge is a local Deskflow derivative for sharing keyboard and mouse input over an encrypted local network connection.
LanBridge 基于 Deskflow，通过加密的局域网连接共享 Linux 与 Mac 的键盘和鼠标，提供中文设置、紧急返回和故障恢复。
